survey: A sci-fi control console on a metal tile floor, seen from slightly above and to the front-right. The main body is a box with a nearly front-facing front face holding a drawer with a bar handle. The right side face recedes up and to the right, and the console stands flat on the floor, casting a soft contact shadow. The top is a sloped panel that rises toward the back, where a raised rail runs along its top edge. On the panel are two round gauges (white and green) at the upper left, eight round buttons in two staggered rows below them, and a lever housing block at the right with a vertical shaft and a red ball knob. Edges parallel to the front get steadily flatter from the bottom edge up through the drawer and the panel's front lip to the back rail. That fits a camera above the object, with one vanishing point off to the left. The front and drawer verticals stay vertical. The side face's receding edges and the right-hand floor seam head to the same upper-right direction. The floor seam at the bottom left runs parallel to the console's base. The two button rows run parallel to the panel's front and back edges. The tops of the gauges and buttons are wide ellipses, and their narrowness fits a panel tilted up toward a camera above it. The lever block sits square on the panel. Its shaft is vertical, which suits a lever pivoting in a slot. The box sits flat on the floor plane as the floor is drawn.
